item.title: Godot GDScript/C# Benchmark
item.description: Yesterday I found this Godot little bench I created a few years ago to quickly evaluate whether Godot GDScript’s interpreter is fast enough for a commercial project that could possibly target Nintendo Switch. This was important because I’ve been biten by cpython in the past (py2.7) where a simple 2D arcady game struggled to reach 60 fps on certain underpowered laptops to my disappointment.. and GDScript while not python is almost identical in many ways.
